info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Support Tickets Prioritys-v2-spec
info.description: The Support Ticket Priorities API allows users to access a comprehensive list of available priorities for support tickets. This functionality aids organizations in categorizing and prioritizing issues efficiently, ensuring timely responses to high-impact queries. Typical consumers include customer support teams and IT service management tools that integrate ticketing systems. By utilizing this API, developers can enhance their applications with priority data that streamlines support workflows and improves overall service quality.

get.description: Fetches the priority levels assigned to tickets in the system, enabling users to understand their current categorization and urgency. This information is essential for effective ticket management and response strategies.

requestBody.description: Request body to fetch ticket priority details. Ensure that the request is properly formatted according to the specified schema.

204.description: Request completed successfully with no content returned.

ListSupportTicketsPrioritysRequest.description: Represents the priority level for tickets in the operations request.

ListSupportTicketsPrioritysResponse_204.title: Ticket Priority Response

status.description: Indicates the success or failure of the operation.

referenceNumber.description: A unique reference number associated with the ticket.

resultId.description: An identifier for the result of the operation.

state.description: The current state of the ticket.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the request in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the operation.

ListSupportTicketsPrioritysResponse_204.description: Schema representing the response for the ticket priority operations.

AuditInfo.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: The user who created the ticket.
